## Overview

This [[adyen]] **Google Pay for Web** page is an integration chooser for a website. It points readers to Google Pay **Web Drop-in** and **Web Components**, with broader Web Drop-in and Components documentation. The page itself is navigation; its short link descriptions do not establish child-guide prerequisites, version requirements, live availability, or a payment outcome. [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Drop-in route:** The page labels Web Drop-in an all-in-one UI solution for adding Google Pay to a website and links `/payment-methods/google-pay/web-drop-in`. See raw lines 19–23.
- **Components route:** The page labels the Web Component a pre-built Component to render Google Pay on a website and links `/payment-methods/google-pay/web-component`. See raw lines 25–27.
- **General background:** It also links `/online-payments/drop-in-web` and `/online-payments/components-web`. See raw line 29.
